Hi there! If your bank transfer has cleared on your side but hasn’t shown up in your Meridian account, our billing team needs a few details to trace it:

1. The exact transfer date
2. The amount transferred
3. The reference/description used on the transfer

Please send those details to our billing team (support@meridian.com or via the help widget). They’ll match the incoming payment to the correct invoice and apply it to your account. Bank transfers can take a bit longer to reconcile than card payments, so this investigation is handled case‑by‑case.

Let us know if you need anything else!
